transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for joining today's readiness huddle. As you know, we have one Saturday mobile vaccination clinic available this month, and it can operate at either the Eastside Community Center or the Westside Library. Before I make the final site decision and sign the operational plan, I need each of you to report your requirements. Public health nursing, please share your clinical requirements. Pharmacy logistics, please report on supply needs. And community outreach, let us know your access requirements. Once I have all three reports, I'll determine the best site and finalize the plan.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: The county's current allocation list records 31 children aged six months through four years in the Eastside service area, and county policy requires the Saturday session serving that group to use the pediatric mRNA formulation at Eastside Community Center. I received the updated list from the county nurse coordinator this morning.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I've verified the facilities records for Eastside Community Center: it has a validated vaccine refrigerator with capacity for 80 doses at 2-8 degrees Celsius, and per pharmacy policy, we must complete an opening temperature-log check at 08:00 before any doses can be released there. That's confirmed with facilities.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Eastside Community Center's partner organization has confirmed 48 appointments beginning at 09:00 on Saturday, with an American Sign Language interpreter reserved for that session. I received the confirmation directly from the partner's program director.
